item.title: I need to decide if 1KB means 1,000 bytes or 1,024 bytes in …
item.author: Simon Willison (@simonwillison.net)
item.description:
I need to decide if 1KB means 1,000 bytes or 1,024 bytes in all of my software

I was leaning 1,024 but it looks like macOS and Windows both define KB as 1,000 these days

I want whatever people are most likely to understand

(I do not think most people know what KiB or MiB means)
